Chapter 751: Chapter 34: Through The Ages (8000 Words, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 751: Chapter 34: Through the Ages (8000 words, please subscribe)

“Can’t push it?”

Lin Yuan frowned.

The force he used to push the heavenly gate was not his full strength.

But what was Lin Yuan’s power? The 50th Realm of the Witch Ancestor! And a Witch Ancestor of the 50th Realm with each realm in complete perfection!

Even if he used only a tenth, or even a hundredth of his strength, it was enough to utterly suppress and thrash the Four Divine Kings and other Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives.

And now he couldn’t move the heavenly gate?

...

“There’s a problem.”

Lin Yuan withdrew his hands, carefully observing the heavenly gate before him.

The force he had just exerted was perhaps tens of thousands of times that of the native Witch Emperors and Witch Ancestors, yet he couldn’t budge the heavenly gate at all.

So, how did the native Witch Emperors and Witch Ancestors manage to open the heavenly gate, and then enter it in the past?

Lin Yuan’s thoughts diverged, and after pondering for a moment, he decided to try pushing the heavenly gate again.

Placing his palms flat on the gate, Lin Yuan centered himself and quietly closed his eyes.

“Open for me.”

The originally calm Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes, a terrifying aura bursting forth instantly. The air around him nearly solidified, his potent blood energy surging like a vast ocean, making the entire mountaintop seem as if it were teetering on the brink, ready to collapse under the force of Lin Yuan’s outburst.

All-out effort.

This was the first time in two hundred years that Lin Yuan had gone all-out.

Since stepping into the 20th Realm of the Witch Ancestor, Lin Yuan had never unleashed his full power because there had been no adversary worthy of such respect.

Rumbling thunderously.

The terrifying blood energy was boiling like scorching magma.

Beneath the summit, many watching powerhouses from the Myriad Clans were trembling uncontrollably in their souls.

The aura that Lin Yuan released at this moment, compared to his earlier scuffle with the Four Divine Kings, was absolutely different, terrifying beyond measure.

“What… what kind of power is this?”

“The human ‘Blood Rain’ just suppressed the Four Divine Kings and didn’t even use his full strength.”

“The mighty Four Divine Kings and six other Eleventh Rank Perfect Lives, not only crushed by a human powerhouse but also without forcing him to reveal his true methods?”

…

The shock among the myriad tribes’ powerhouses can be imagined.

If they hadn’t seen it with their own eyes, they wouldn’t have believed that in this two-dimensional world that suppressed everything, a powerhouse could elevate their strength to such a level.

And that it was a human Evolver?

…

“Still can’t push it open?”

Even after giving his all, Lin Yuan still couldn’t move the heavenly gate before him.

“The amount of power I’m currently unleashing could penetrate this Heavenly Mountain beneath my feet, yet I can’t open this heavenly gate?”

Lin Yuan found it absurd.

If the heavenly gate was truly so difficult to open, then how did those native Witch Emperors and Witch Ancestors who managed to open it explain it?

Could it be that this heavenly gate distinguished who was pushing it?

Was there a different standard for powerhouses from the Myriad Clans pushing the heavenly gate compared to the native powerhouses?

Even if the standards were different, with Lin Yuan’s current power, he should have reached the threshold, right?

“I don’t believe, with my current power, I can’t open this mere heavenly gate.”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned solemn, and having used almost all conventional methods, he was left with only the moves he would use in a life-and-death situation.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged, and everything happening in the two-dimensional world was no different from what his real body underwent.

“Divine Skill… Strengthening!”

Lin Yuan whispered, and in an instant, deep within his body, the Divine Ability Imprint belonging to the ‘Strengthening’ Divine Skill began to spread pervasively, enveloping his flesh, soul, and everything else.

In the two-dimensional world, where all supernatural methods were suppressed, including Physical Body Divine Abilities.

Thus, the Taiyang Divine Spirit in the two-dimensional world couldn’t activate any Physical Body Divine Ability.

However, his real body outside the two-dimensional world could.

The ‘Strengthening’ Divine Skill, once activated, would enhance everything about Lin Yuan tenfold, including his physical body, soul, spirit will, and so on.

And while the Taiyang Divine Spirit in the two-dimensional world was isolated physically and spiritually, the spirit will was not.

This meant that once Lin Yuan’s true body activated the ‘Strengthening’ Divine Skill, the spirit will of the Taiyang Divine Spirit in the two-dimensional world would increase tenfold.

Even though spirit will could not directly increase strength, it allowed more precise control over power, which could then unleash greater strength.

Why do Eleventh Rank powerhouses among the Myriad Clans rise so much faster and grow quicker than those of the Ninth and Tenth Ranks?

Own realm was one factor, a strong spirit will was another.

Therefore—

The dramatic increase in Lin Yuan’s spirit will significantly boosted his strength.

Rumbling thunderously.

Accompanied by a tenfold increase in Lin Yuan’s spirit will, the quasi-ethereal blood and fire surrounding him seemed to emanate an even more terrifying aura.

At that moment, the many Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses watching from the mountainside were so shocked they were rendered speechless.

To them, Lin Yuan felt even more majestic and imposing than the Heavenly Mountain beneath their feet, as if he were about to break the many constraints of the two-dimensional world and break free.

A moment later.

The aura emitted by Lin Yuan gradually retracted.

Even after using the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Strengthening’, he still hadn’t shaken the heavenly gate in the slightest, let alone opened it.

After using the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Strengthening’, Lin Yuan would experience a brief period of weakness.

Yet to the many Myriad Tribes’ powerhouses at the mountainside, this so-called weakness was barely noticeable as he only temporarily fell from the Witch Ancestor Fifty Realm to the Witch Ancestor Forty-fifth Realm.
